test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-4) Official paper (Held On: 10 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Shubham secured 345 marks out of 600 in the annual examination. Find the percentage of marks obtained by him in the examination.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Required Percentage = (Marks Obtained ÷ Total Marks) × 100

Required Percentage = (345 ÷ 600) × 100

Required Percentage = 345 ÷ 6 = 57.5%

**∴ The correct option is A.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Marks obtained by Shubham = 345

Total maximum marks = 600

**Formula Used:**

Percentage = (Value obtained ÷ Total Value) × 100

 
 
 0
 345 (Obtained)
 600 (Total)
 
• 
 Percentage = (345 ÷ 600) × 100

**Calculations:**

⇒ Required Percentage = (345 ÷ 600) × 100

⇒ Percentage = 345 ÷ 6

⇒ Percentage = 57.5%

**∴ The correct option is A.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage Change

Percentage Increase/Decrease = (Difference ÷ Original Value) × 100.

Fraction to Percentage Conversion

To convert any fraction x/y into a percentage, multiply it by 100. Example: 1/4 × 100 = 25%.

Decimal to Percentage

Multiply the decimal by 100 and add the % sign. Example: 0.575 × 100 = 57.5%.</p
